phrases.text: Morning. We appear to be doing this again.
A day off. Please do less.
The task connection is awake. I suppose I am too.
You are back. I guarded the desktop.
Battery is at twenty percent. Just mentioning it.
Ten percent. The charger would be useful now.
Five percent. This is becoming a situation.
Three percent. Please plug it in.
Something did not connect. I am as disappointed as you are.
Memory stayed too high. I am sinking for now.
